context._comment_cloudfrontPrefixListId: The CloudFront origin-facing managed prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing) has a REGION-SPECIFIC id. By default the network stack resolves it with a context lookup at synth time (requires credentials). For credential-free synth/CI, pass the id for YOUR region explicitly: `-c cloudfrontPrefixListId=pl-...` (find it: aws ec2 describe-managed-prefix-lists --filters Name=prefix-list-name,Values=com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing).
